scenes.title: Six Forty-Five
scenes.summary: At dawn Chen draws Qing a street map to the old hardware shop across the bridge before guests wake up.

scenes.title: The Blue Door
scenes.summary: Across the river Qing calls Chen from the square to check the last turn and finds the right brass valve.

scenes.title: Hot Cinnamon Rolls
scenes.summary: Downstairs Mei and Zhou tempt early-rising Song with fresh cinnamon rolls before anyone turns on a cold tap.

scenes.title: Down in the Cellar
scenes.summary: In the cellar Chen and Qing swap in the new brass valve and bring hot water roaring back through the house.

scenes.title: Five-Star Showers
scenes.summary: Hao praises the hot shower at breakfast while flustered Zhou accidentally hints that they read his notebook.

scenes.title: The Acoustic Architect
scenes.summary: Under the courtyard tree, Hao shows Qing and Mei his sketches: he studies quiet courtyard acoustics, not hotel stars.

scenes.title: Sunlight on the Tag
scenes.summary: While airing out the luggage closet, Chen brings out the blue suitcase and Song recognises the old address in daylight.

scenes.title: The Boy on the Stairs
scenes.summary: In the courtyard Song describes the quiet younger brother listening from the stairs just as Hao walks out and hears her.
